description: Prepares an order or quote request for one service with the person's own details and the totals from quote_order. Sends the person a confirmation email, which cannot be unsent. Nothing is ordered and no terms are accepted until the person opens the link, reads the terms and confirms.

groups.description: Number of groups for training, 1 by default

monthly.description: Add the monthly option where choices.monthly exists

tier.description: Tier id, required for training (see choices.tiers)

expected.description: The totals from quote_order that the person saw and agreed to

fields.description: The buyer's answers, keyed by the field names quote_order returns in form.fields

name: request_order
title: Request an order
